peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: SKHX 39.0% with 3/3 replicate support; MU 24.8% with 3/3 replicate support; SNDK 16.7% with 3/3 replicate support; DRAM 12.4% with 3/3 replicate support; CXMT 7.1% with 2/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: SK hynix common
peers.reason: SK hynix common is the closest listed comparator: it shares Samsung's core DRAM and NAND cycle, the same memory pricing and inventory drivers, and the same South Korea home-market exposure. The common share is preferred to the ADR because it is the directly traded underlying rather than a wrapper.

peers.name: Micron Technology
peers.reason: Micron is a direct substitute in DRAM and NAND memory, so its returns are driven by the same memory supply-demand and pricing cycle that dominates Samsung's semiconductor earnings; 24-hour perp liquidity is 59.489 USD millions.

peers.name: Sandisk
peers.reason: Sandisk gives concentrated NAND flash and storage exposure that shares Samsung's memory cycle as the same underlying exposure rather than a remote factor analogy; it is also the most liquid name in the basket at 250.017 USD millions per 24 hours.

peers.name: Roundhill Memory ETF
peers.reason: The Roundhill Memory ETF is an unleveraged sector index that captures the dominant DRAM and NAND systematic exposure behind Samsung's returns, so it earns a meaningful peer weight rather than being treated as a generic risk-on proxy; 24-hour perp liquidity is 63.645 USD millions.

peers.name: CXMT Corp. Class A
peers.reason: CXMT is the leading Chinese DRAM manufacturer and a direct supply-side competitor whose capacity additions influence global DRAM pricing and Samsung's memory margins. It trades about 33.928 USD millions per 24 hours, sufficient for a mid-sized peer weight.

primary_index_hedge.name: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF
primary_index_hedge.reason: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF is the most direct listed hedge for Samsung Electronics common because Samsung is the dominant exposure in the South Korea equity market; it hedges home-market index, currency-translation, and local risk-premium moves that SP500 or XYZ100 would only partly capture.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract
